wrong.new: `list` forwards `project_id`, `name`, `admin_state_up`, `shared`, `sort_key` and `sort_dir` to Neutron (everything except `searchTerm` and `status`).
wrong.evidence: networksRouter.ts:39 `const { searchTerm, status, ...openstackFilters } = input`; line 42 `appendQueryParamsFromObject(openstackFilters)`.
